findings.body: Adding the second Ubuntu entry makes `test_1_ubuntu_test_job_allows_ten_minutes` fail: `tests/test_fix_ubuntu_ci_timeout.py:13` asserts that the Ubuntu timeout matches equal `["10"]`, but this workflow produces `["10", "10"]`. CI runs this test through `pytest tests`, so the branch leaves the suite red and does not meet Done-when. Update the workflow test to verify groups 1 and 2 of 2, each with a 10-minute limit, and run it. The reported close run selected no tests, so its zero exit status does not establish that this check passes.
